spec.material: the lesson note for one step of a lesson: the mathematics the step teaches, in the shape its kind of step needs
spec.audience: the teacher who will teach this lesson to the class
requirements: Write for the teacher, not the learner: notes to teach from, not a script to read out.
Write what is to be taught, never a record of a lesson already taught.

parts.name: explanation
parts.description: The mathematics the step teaches, stated for the class to copy: definitions, rules, properties and facts, with lists and tables where they help. Leave it out for an evaluation step

parts.name: worked_examples
parts.description: Graded examples, each solved line by line, for a step that works problems

fields.name: solution
fields.description: The solution, one line of working at a time

fields.name: working
fields.description: One line of the working, in LaTeX between $ signs

fields.name: commentary
fields.description: Why this line follows, in one short sentence

parts.name: classwork
parts.description: Questions the class works in the step, of the kind the step teaches, each with its answer

fields.name: answer
fields.description: The answer, with the working where there is any
